prompt:
Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration.

Visual DNA:
Pure white background. Minimalist black hand-drawn line art. Slightly wobbly pen lines. Lots of empty white space. Sparse warm-gold, red, and blue handwritten Chinese annotations. Clean absurd product-sketch feeling. No gradients, no shadows, no paper texture, no complex background, no commercial vector style, no PPT infographic look, no cute mascot poster, no children's illustration, no realistic UI.

Recurring IP character required:
小黑, a small solid-black cat with white dot eyes, simple pointed ears, a short tail, tiny thin legs, blank serious expression, slightly uneven hand-drawn body shape. 小黑 must perform the core conceptual action, not decorate the scene. Make 小黑 serious, deadpan, and slightly bizarre, not cute or kawaii.

Theme:
Qwen and Fable repeatedly choose the same frontend layout skeleton but express different visual taste.

Structure type:
概念隐喻 / 双人改造场景

Core idea:
Two serious black cats receive the same bare wireframe house frame. One carefully fits rounded amber panels and playful ornaments; the other fits compact square panels, serif labels, and denser shelves. The structural frame is identical, but the finished surfaces clearly differ.

Composition:
A single bare architectural frame sits in the center, split only by a thin vertical construction line, not a formal comparison chart. On the left, one 小黑 uses a ruler to attach compact rectangular panels and neatly stacked shelves. On the right, another 小黑 bends a warm-gold panel into a rounded shape and hangs one playful ornament. The shared roof beam and columns visibly continue across both halves. Leave the upper third mostly blank.

Suggested elements:
shared wireframe house skeleton / compact square panels / rounded warm-gold panels / serif specimen card / geometric sans specimen card / two tiny toolboxes

Chinese handwritten labels:
同一骨架 / Fable / Qwen / 视觉选择 / 各有审美

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) only for Qwen's rounded panel and one connecting construction line. Red only for one tiny mistake mark. Blue only for one secondary note. Do not use orange.

Constraints:
One image explains only one core structure. Keep the main subject around 45%-55% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Use at most five short handwritten Chinese labels. Do not write a title in the top-left corner. Do not write the structure type on the image. Do not make it a formal diagram, course slide, dense explainer, or split-screen UI. Invent a fresh visual metaphor. It should be clear but not instructional, interesting but not childish, strange but clean.
